contentText: European leaders have agreed to nominate the former head of the Bank of Spain as the next president of the European Central Bank. Pablo ​Hernandez ‌de ⁠Cos will replace the outgoing Christine Lagarde as the bank faces pressure to tackle high inflation, borrowing costs, and government debt. Also in the show - US regulators give SpaceX the green light to send satellites for data centers into space, and American households face higher costs for their Thanksgiving celebrations.
